title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Suspensions and the Parking Tow Redemption Advance
content:
**Rule.** Where the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement stands suspended, an AutoPay advance is added to the redemption amount under a notice of intent to tow and held as a credit on the agreement: **$15.00** when the authorization was suspended at least 30 days before the handling date, **$7.50** when it was suspended more recently, and nothing when it is not suspended.

Days are calendar days from the authorization's suspension date to the handling date. The records read are the authorization's status (suspended) and its suspension date.

| Authorization on the agreement | Suspended how long before the handling date | Advance |
|---|---|---|
| Suspended | 30 days or more | $15.00 |
| Suspended | fewer than 30 days | $7.50 |
| Active, cancelled, or none | — | nothing |

Hypothetical cases (handling date 31 May): suspended 1 May — 30 days before, $15.00; suspended 2 May — 29 days before, $7.50; authorization active — nothing.
